status: Illustrative research simulation contract; not a manufacturing release specification
notes: Only valid results from this batch, using assay version 1.0, collected at or after the checkpoint count.
A valid failing checkpoint assay implies reject. Invalid or pending assays imply hold until replacement evidence arrives.
Observed process excursions and unresolved instrument discrepancies imply hold, even after recovery.
All required evidence passing, process complete, and no unresolved history issues implies accept in this simulation only.
Phenotype represents an undifferentiated-state measurement; it is not a functional pluripotency test.
Genomic and microbial results are simulated screen outcomes, not comprehensive safety evidence.
